public.credit_notes.Customers read their.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM orders o
  WHERE ((o.id = credit_notes.order_id) AND (lower(o.customer_email) = lower(auth.email())))))

public.order_invoice_snapshots.Read with.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM orders o
  WHERE (o.id = order_invoice_snapshots.order_id)))

public.product_images.Public can view im.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_images.product_id) AND p.is_active)))

public.style_submissions.Purchasers subm.check: ((user_id = auth.uid()) AND has_purchased(product_id) AND (consented_at IS NOT NULL) AND (status = 'pending'::text))
